# NeuralNg Field

> Accessible Angular 22+ field composition at `@neural-ng/core/field`.

## Rules

- Import `NeuralField`, `NeuralFieldLabel`, `NeuralFieldHint`,
  `NeuralFieldError`, and `NeuralFieldControl` from
  `@neural-ng/core/field`. Never generate the deprecated `FieldComponent` or
  `Field*Directive` aliases.
- Generate `<neural-field controlId="stable-id">`; `controlId` is required.
- Use `<label neuralFieldLabel>` for the visible native label.
- Use `[neuralFieldHint]` for instructions and `[neuralFieldError]` for
  correction messages.
- Do not manually add `for`, control `id`, or generated hint/error IDs in a
  normal Field composition. Field derives them from `controlId`.
- `neuralInput` consumes Field context automatically.
- Apply `neuralFieldControl` to another native or compatible custom control.
- Keep validation rules in the form schema. Field displays state; it does not
  validate or own values.
- For Signal Forms, normally bind Field `invalid` to
  `field().touched() && field().invalid()`.
- Bind `pending`, `required`, `disabled`, and `readonly` from the same source of
  truth as the control.
- Use `describedBy` only for additional description IDs outside Field.
- `neuralFieldError` uses `aria-live="polite"` by default. Use assertive
  announcements sparingly.
- Use native `class` attributes directly. Do not invent `fieldClass`,
  `labelClass`, `hintClass`, or `errorClass` inputs.
- `unstyled` removes visual classes but must preserve structural hooks, state
  classes, native semantics, IDs, and ARIA relationships.
- Do not add validation logic, translated error maps, floating-label behavior,
  prefix/suffix controls, or form summaries to this primitive.

## Canonical example

```ts
import { FormField, email, form, required } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import {
  NeuralField,
  NeuralFieldError,
  NeuralFieldHint,
  NeuralFieldLabel,
} from '@neural-ng/core/field';
import { NeuralInput } from '@neural-ng/core/input';
```

```html
<neural-field
  controlId="account-email"
  fluid
  required
  [invalid]="
    accountForm.email().touched() && accountForm.email().invalid()
  "
  [pending]="accountForm.email().pending()"
>
  <label neuralFieldLabel>Email</label>
  <input
    neuralInput
    type="email"
    autocomplete="email"
    [formField]="accountForm.email"
  />
  <small neuralFieldHint>Use your work address.</small>
  @if (accountForm.email().touched() && accountForm.email().invalid()) {
    <small neuralFieldError>
      {{ accountForm.email().errors()[0]?.message }}
    </small>
  }
</neural-field>
```

The rendered input receives `id="account-email"`. The label receives
`for="account-email"`, the hint receives `id="account-email-hint"`, and the
conditional error receives `id="account-email-error"`. Field keeps
`aria-describedby` synchronized.
